sweeping-view.config.title: Sweeping View
sweeping-view.option.boxStrokeEnabled.de: Draws the outline of the volume a sweep attack hits.
sweeping-view.option.boxFillEnabled.desc: Fills the sweep volume with a translucent colour.
sweeping-view.option.boxFillColor.desc: Colour of the box faces. The alpha byte sets how dense they are.
sweeping-view.option.sphereEnabled.desc: Draws the 3 block reach limit around the attacker.
sweeping-view.option.sphereColor.desc: Colour of the sphere surface. The alpha byte sets how dense it is.
